iclr-2026.name: ICLR 2026
iclr-2026.applies_to: Learning representations research; use the official target-year policy for actual submission.
iclr-2026.limits: Original qualitative mapping, not a verified official numeric review form. No SOTA requirement by itself.

neurips-2026.name: NeurIPS 2026
neurips-2026.applies_to: Select general, theory, use-inspired, concept-and-feasibility, or negative-results contribution before interpreting criteria.
neurips-2026.limits: Theory does not require empirical validation. Originality includes insights and problem framing, not just new algorithms.

acm-artifacts.name: ACM artifact evaluation
acm-artifacts.applies_to: Computational artifacts; check the target venue's current badge policy separately.
acm-artifacts.limits: Self-assessment does not award an ACM badge. Availability, functionality and independent reproduction are separate.

medical-reporting.name: Health research reporting selector
medical-reporting.applies_to: Choose CONSORT for randomized trials, STROBE for observational studies, PRISMA for systematic reviews, SRQR/COREQ for applicable qualitative designs, STARD/TRIPOD for diagnostic/prediction research, ARRIVE for animal research.
medical-reporting.limits: Selector only, not an embedded full checklist. Fetch and cite the exact guideline/version. Reporting completeness is not risk-of-bias assessment, evidence certainty, clinical advice or ethical approval.

apa-jars.name: APA JARS
apa-jars.applies_to: Psychological research: choose JARS-Quant, JARS-Qual or JARS-Mixed according to method; consider JARS-REC where applicable.
apa-jars.limits: Original summary, not a complete APA checklist or a numerical quality scale. Use the official checklist for full reporting audit.

public-humanities.name: Public Humanities review guidance
public-humanities.applies_to: Context-sensitive humanities review; check fit to the journal and the relevant call for papers. Do not generalize one journal's editorial priorities to all humanities.
public-humanities.limits: Original working adaptation of reviewer guidance, not an official numeric form. Interpretive disagreement requires reasoned engagement, not automatic rejection.

stanford-agentic-reference.name: Stanford Agentic Reviewer inspired dimensions
stanford-agentic-reference.applies_to: Optional structured feedback lens. Seven dimensions are adapted qualitatively; experiment soundness applies only when experiments are part of the work.
stanford-agentic-reference.limits: No Stanford service integration, endorsement, model weights or calibration are included. Their ICLR-2025 result used 150 training and 147 test submissions and does not validate this implementation or other fields.
